items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: I had this Matoya fella... we had picture of Pierron and all that. Now he was a fine violin player.

ctx.x: The Climbing player. The Climbing player. He got killed. Well that's Warren Bell, that's Warren Bell's uncle. You tell me about that.

Cause his daughter had asked me if I had his picture, you know. And all, but I didn't have none of them. I had this Matoya fella. You ever heard of Matoya? Oh no, Matoya. He was great, you know. And, uh, we had picture of Pierron and all that. Now he was a fine violin player. And I think a little while before he died, uh, we had read of them or he told all somebody's stories about it. It was very expensive, I think. He was great cause he played out there, uh, I'll tell you that. West End or something. I could…
I never saw him, but I know plenty of people worked with him.
